The mayor helped, and the company reported inflated furnace capacity to retain. In gratitude, Wang Moujia gave cash 50,000 USD (approx 350k RMB?) and later 300,000 RMB to the mayor. The prosecution says they obtained improper benefits and gave state staff property, constituting ... likely "受贿" (bribery) for the state staff, and "行贿" (bribe giving) for the company and its director. Also possibly "国有资产侵占" or "滥用职权" but the facts focus on giving money to a state staff for favorable treatment. So crimes: For the company and Wang Moujia: "行贿罪" (giving bribes). The prosecution says "被告单位XX县XX有限公司、被告人王某甲为XX有限公司谋取不正当利益，给予国家工作人员财物，其行为构成××". That is "行贿罪". Also the state staff receiving is "受贿罪". But the defendant is the company and Wang Moujia. The state staff is not a defendant here. So the crime for them is "行贿罪". Also possibly "提供虚假材料" (providing false data) for the furnace capacity, which could be "伪造公司印章、提供虚假材料" but not clearly. The main crime is "行贿罪". Also "滥用职权" not applicable. So answer: [罪名]行贿<eoa>
